item.tib: dmu gshen lha yi gdung rgyud nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar mos ldan thar pa'i lam 'dren
item.coloph: gshen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar 'bring po'i tshul 'di ni/ dmu rgyal gong ma mtshungs med lung rtogs kyi gshog rlabs mnga' ba'i khyung chen rim byon gyi rjes 'jug pa/ bdag 'dra thos med sbung chung b+h+ya ma ra la co 'dri ba mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang rgyal du 'bod pas/ dad 'dun mos pa'i sgo nas yi ger bkod kyang / bslab sbyang gi yon tan cha 'phra ba'i skyon gyis/ nor 'khrul ra chod du gyur pa ci mchis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags shing*/ 'di bzhengs dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa des/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rab tu dar ba dang / de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu gnas 'di dang phyogs gang dang gang du bzhugs pa tshang ma'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing*/ 'gro don 'phrin las rgyas pa dang / ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang bde skyid kyi dpal la longs su spyod cing / rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / mthar yang bla med g.yung drung gi snying po 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bdag gis bsngo zhing*/ bsngos pa ji bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/
